title: Samsung SSD Awesomeness
summary: A Samsung-backed viral demo that builds a fast computer from 24 256GB MLC SSDs in a RAID 0 array and shows the throughput results.
why: HN passed it around in 2009 as a funny, impressive demo of SSD speed despite its marketing origin.

quote.text: Samsung has a funny and impressive "viral" ad video showing 24 SSD drives in a RAID array.
